title: Use CapCut Seedance 2.0 Mini instead of Seedance 2.0 when you want ~30% lower…
content:
Use CapCut Seedance 2.0 Mini instead of Seedance 2.0 when you want ~30% lower generation cost and ~2× faster renders with quality comparable to Seedance 2.0 Fast.

Generate 5 creative variations from a single prompt (different styles/feels) in ~10 minutes, then pick the best version to refine.

Start with a single-line prompt and use CapCut Director Mode to auto-expand it into a full script/storyboard (characters, scenes, shot sequence/camera shots) before generating.

Adopt an iterate-and-compare workflow: generate multiple versions first instead of trying to make the first output perfect, then polish the strongest result inside CapCut.
